exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production game VFX sprite atlas, transparent RGBA, square 1024 by 1024.
Primary request: A single 2 by 2 evenly spaced sprite atlas of four beautiful isolated sci-fi fantasy combat effects for a lightweight browser game inspired by polished astral JRPG battles. These are luminous effect sprites, NOT icons or UI cards.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent empty background, no black fill, no checkerboard, no ground or environment.
Composition/framing: Divide the whole square into four equal 512 by 512 invisible cells. Each effect centered exactly at its own cell center, contained in the middle 70% of that cell with ample completely transparent margins, zero effect spill between cells. Orthographic front view. Do not draw cell borders.
Upper-left cell: cyan-white crescent blade slash crossing a brilliant compact star impact; elegant tapered arc, tiny sharp light shards, energetic readable shape.
Upper-right cell: icy cyan translucent shield halo, circular rim and hexagonal crystalline facets, bright rim accents, transparent open center, luminous protective ring.
Lower-left cell: jade and mint healing ring with gently rising small diamond motes, soft luminous swirl and a few sparkles, transparent open center, readable restorative energy.
Lower-right cell: violet and gold stellar resonance ring, refined orbit lines and a small four-point starburst, transparent open center, dynamic cosmic energy.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted 2D game VFX, crisp luminous strokes, restrained bloom, saturated jewel tones, polished cosmic science-fantasy. Beautiful at 128 px per effect, strong uncluttered silhouette.
Lighting/mood: vibrant radiant energy, controlled glow fading smoothly to actual transparency.
Constraints: only these four effects; truly transparent backgrounds; each sprite clearly separated; no characters, no objects, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logos, no interface, no panel framing. Keep all pixels within their individual cells, generous transparent padding.

processing.method: Pillow crop, resize, transparent padding, and WebP compression only; no painted replacement content

cells.description: Cyan-white crescent slash and star impact
Icy cyan shield ring and crystalline facets
Jade healing ring and rising diamond motes

provenance: AI generated for this project by the built-in OpenAI image generation tool. No reference images supplied. Abstract effects only; not extracted from HoYoverse or other games.

inspection.visual: Inspected generated source and compressed atlas; four distinct luminous sprites, legible at browser overlay scale, transparent cell padding, no words or logos
inspection.alpha: Decoded final WebP and confirmed genuine alpha range 0-255; every sprite cell has a 38 px transparent safety margin
inspection.performance_scope: One 89.52 KiB 512x512 atlas shared by all effect types. Animation timing and runtime performance validated separately by application checks.
